title: Bahamas yacht trips with Eldridge Reeves Johnson

tellings.quote: They they they also went on these sort of trips to the Bahamas on this yacht owned by this guy Eldridge Reeves Johnson

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, drawing on the book A Man Called Intrepid, tells of a circle that included a researcher named Townsend Brown and a man named William Stephenson. He says they went on trips to the Bahamas on a yacht owned by a man named Eldridge Reeves Johnson. He brings it up to suggest these figures were tied together in a hidden network behind the UFO story.
